_comment: Devices and cookware. `staple: true` means the app assumes you have it (you can still switch it off in the app). `alternates` describes what you can cook a recipe with when you do not have the device it asks for, plus the adjustment you need to make.

alternates.note: Drop the temperature by about 20C / 25F and start checking 20-25% earlier. Cook in batches - a crowded basket steams instead of crisping.
Raise the temperature by about 20C / 25F and add roughly a third to the time. Use the top rack and turn things halfway.
Works for anything flat - patties, paneer, chicken pieces. Press them down, do not move them for the first few minutes.
For thin cuts and patties only. Medium heat, lid on to cook through, lid off at the end to brown.
Only for reheating and softening - never for anything that needs to be crisp or browned.
Roughly triple the time, keep it covered, and top up hot water as it evaporates.
Low for 6-8 hours, or high for 3-4.
For dals and soft vegetables, mash through a sieve or with the back of a ladle. Coarser, but it works.
Use the cooker as a steamer: an inch of water, a stand, lid on WITHOUT the weight.
Any deep pan with a lid and a small stand or ring inside. Keep an inch of simmering water below the food.
Same thing without the char lines. Get the pan properly hot before the food goes in.
Dry pan, medium heat, a minute a side.
Cook the same batter as pancakes.
Cook in batches on the stovetop instead of roasting in one go.
